title: Chicken and duck blood soup
lead:
{{Short description|Shanghainese soup-based blood dish}}
'''Chicken and duck blood soup''' ({{zh|s=鸡鸭血汤 |p=jī yā xiě tāng}}) is a [[Shanghai]]nese soup-based [[blood soup|blood dish]], using the blood of [[Chicken as food|chicken]] and [[Duck as food|duck]] as a principal ingredient. Created by Xu Fuquan, a hawker from Shanghai, and described to be sour and spicy in taste, the dish is viewed as a healthy food with medicinal value in Shanghai.
